# AuraRealty — Next-Generation AI Real Estate & Intelligent Living

> AuraRealty empowers homebuyers, investors, and developers to explore residential and commercial properties globally with neural property search, market valuation analysis, and autonomous listing synthesis.

## What AuraRealty Is

AuraRealty is an AI-first real estate and architectural intelligence platform. Users search for luxury apartments, contemporary villas, penthouses, and estates using conversational natural language, backed by multimodal analysis and algorithmic investment metrics.

## Core Features

- **AI Property Search**: Intuitive natural language queries powered by high-capacity reasoning models. Real-time scraping and indexing of active market inventory.
- **Location & Yield Analytics**: Autonomous trend prediction, neighborhood appreciation signals, and micro-market analysis.
- **Direct Listing Portal**: Verified homeowners and premier agencies showcase properties with verified credentials.
- **Concierge Viewings**: Instant reservation and scheduling of private tours.
- **Admin Command Center**: Complete property verification and platform intelligence suite.

## Global Coverage

New York, San Francisco, London, Dubai, Singapore, Mumbai, Bangalore, New Delhi

## Property Classifications

Architectural Villas, Penthouses, Designer Lofts, Waterfront Estates, Ultra-Modern Residences

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite
- Backend: Node.js + Express + MongoDB
- AI Reasoning: Multimodal LLM Architecture
- Auth: JWT + Secure httpOnly Refresh Tokens
